Variants.Content: Bread is the simplest and most sensitive political language in the Seven Kingdoms. The lords regarded white bread as a sign of wealth at the banquet, while the peasants judged whether they could survive the winter from rye, oats and a pot of gruel; once the price of food in a city got out of control, Iron Throne, the placeBoth lords and traders will be questioned by the same wave of hunger.
